answer: Every claim climbs the jetty of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sonnet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. By the dawn of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, published publicly on failure, no identity may audit its own recruit.
